title: AI Agile Issue Audit
description: Schema for the structured evidence object the issue-obsolescence-audit agent produces per issue. The agent reports evidence items; pipeline/issue_audit_outcome.py's derive_audit_verdict computes the verdict from them, never the model's own narrative conclusion (issue #743, same discipline as pr-review.schema.json / issue #512 Part 2).

type.description: The kind of evidence: code-removed (mechanism no longer exists), code-changed (behavior now contradicts the issue), merged-fix (a commit/PR already implements the fix), superseding-issue (a broader issue makes this one moot), contradicted (gap is still present), unverifiable (cannot be checked by static read).

confidence.description: Confidence this evidence item is accurate. 0.85 is the closing threshold: derive_audit_verdict closes the issue only when at least one closing-direction item reaches this value.

citation.description: File path (+ line), commit SHA, or issue number supporting this claim. Required for every type except unverifiable. A bare assertion with no citation is not acceptable.

excerpt.description: The specific line(s) read from the file, commit, or issue that support the claim.
